At 1:30, the group guide number 24 Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding an unpleasant and humiliating experience that occurred this afternoon (October 26, 2025) at the entrance of Borobudur Temple.
During my visit, I was publicly and harshly scolded by the tour guide of Group No. 24 in front of numerous tourists, including visitors from various countries. The guide spoke loudly and aggressively, which made me feel deeply humiliated and personally attacked. Such behavior is highly unprofessional and seriously damages the image of Borobudur as a world-class heritage site known for its hospitality and cultural value.
I kindly request the management to take the following actions:
Conduct an investigation to verify the incident and identify the guide involved;
Require a formal apology from the guide;
Strengthen training and management of all guides to ensure professionalism and respect toward visitors;
Provide me with an official written response regarding the findings and actions taken.
I sincerely hope the management team will handle this matter seriously and take appropriate steps to prevent such incidents in the future.
Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to your prompt and considerate response.
Kind regards,
Simon
